title: Zero set-aside buffer on the sDOLA destination departs from story 091 Decision 6 / story 082 Phase 4 with no authorising story
description: Story 091 L97 and Decision 6 (L195-197) say: 'V2's buffer pct on the destination = V1's pct read from the source in Phase 0'. Story 082 L73 (Phase 4) says setSetAsideBuffer(v2, <value read from V1>), and 082 L172 expects DOLA 10. Commit 1349be8 has no [story-NNN] tag. It makes _targetBufferPct return 0 whenever the destination is the sDOLA strategy, and Phase 4, Phase 8 and the verifier assert 0. No story anywhere in ~/code/product-owner/stories/phStaging2 (all states and sprints, latest 097) records this decision. Stories 091 and 082 are auto-complete, so the story tree still describes a 10% DOLA buffer.
impact: No security impact. Law 1 favours the change: the fork harness shows the V2 position on the sDOLA strategy cannot go below par without an owner emergencyWithdraw, so a 10% pct would only have diverted about 10% of DOLA yield into an idle pile that only rescueERC20 can recover. The impact is traceability: the authoritative spec and the shipped script disagree. A later reviewer grading against story 091 would call the zero a defect, and one reading the code would call the story wrong.
recommendation: Record the decision in a story, either as an amendment to 091 Decision 6 or as a new story that cites the monotonicity argument and the zero-buffer rationale. Keep the code as is.
evidence: Story files: 091 L97, L195-197; 082 L73, L172. Commit 1349be8 has no tag. The project fork test test_fork_fullPreview_v2DolaLandsInSdolaStrategy asserts source pct > 0 and destination pct == 0 (PASS).

title: package.json runbook comment still says the set-aside buffer pct is 'copied from V1's source' for every token
description: 1349be8 updated the script header NatSpec (L68-73) but not the operator runbook in package.json L49. The runbook still reads 'Phase 4 ... set-aside buffer pct copied from V1's source'. An operator comparing the runbook to the Phase 4 log line 'setAsideBuffer %: 0' for DOLA may think the run went wrong.
impact: Operator confusion only. The script asserts the correct target, and nothing on chain depends on this text.
recommendation: Change the L49 text to: 'set-aside buffer pct copied from V1's source (USDC/USDe); ZERO on the sDOLA destination (DOLA)'.
evidence: package.json L49. Diff 91ed727..1349be8 does not touch package.json.
